product.name: Nimble Pharmacy Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that integrates with pharmacy management systems to streamline prescription refills, orders, payments, and patient communications.

product.name: Nimble Patient App
product.description: A mobile application that allows patients to securely manage, order, pay for, and receive prescriptions with options for delivery or in-store pickup.

product.name: Pharmacy Integration and Compliance Services
product.description: Services that ensure seamless integration of Nimble’s platform with existing pharmacy systems while maintaining regulatory compliance.

product.name: Life Science Partner Solutions
product.description: Custom-built solutions for Life Science companies to improve patient adherence, reduce prescription abandonment, and target patients effectively using real-time data.
